dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Mm, that unique aroma... I wonder how you'll inspire my cooking this time?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Alright then, I'll just go with the flow. It's about time for a fresh new flavor.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Hmm... I'd say it's quite similar to working at the tavern in the Fleuve Cendre.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: There's something special about seeing diners' faces light up when they taste your food... You don't get that working in the closed-off kitchen in a grand hotel.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: If something like this comes up again, just call me. Don't worry, we know each other. No commission fee needed — I won't take a single Mora.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: It's nothing. Just take care not to overwork yourself!
